race.comment: BUSTER'S BABE (6) has been beaten narrow margins in both runs this campaign and now gets to this third-up with the best recent profile. Her long-neck second to Mystic Smile at Ascot reads well for a maiden of this depth, and the earlier Northam second showed she was ready to win. FALLEN CITY (13) is the danger after placing in NMW1Y grade at Ascot, beaten half a length by Twilight Star, and she now has first-time blinkers, a 3kg claim and a rise in distance. Drawn to get every chance and can play a role again with no weight on her back. VENETIAN GEM (14) made a very sound debut at this track when third to Encroaching, beaten just over a length. Profiles well off the debut run and another forward showing is expected. NICABOOM (12) is another with the blinkers on for the first time today and is drawn to get every chance. Can build on the first-up effort. SECRET SESSION (16) comes from a strong family and has trialled well coming in. Can feature.
